Three illustrated teasers point to Dalma, Dahibara Aloodum and Machha Besara; thematic paths, a collection starter and Where to eat lead elsewhere. Do not confuse this hub with /food/everyday/, /food/fire-cooking/, /food/three-tastes/ or individual dish articles.
routes.byline_sources: No hub byline; leave article author/source treatment on linked narratives. Feature descriptions are abbreviated story invitations with direct article links. Do not interpret the lack of hub footnotes as permission to add new unsupported food claims.

Existing tests verify all regional cards have photos, five scoped mappings retain creator/licence/source/captions and hashes where supplied, and all rendered hub image files decode. No new independent visual-cultural review claimed.

routes.byline_sources: No aggregate byline. Preserve source and author identities within linked articles, including the dated first-person Bhubaneswar photo-story teaser.
